description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
